failure_summary.description: Agents sometimes duplicated endpoints for one result, chose an adjacent rather than exact operation, or missed a distinct requested facet.
Calls omitted or mis-mapped applicable selectors, scope, pagination, canonical values, parameter groups, or value serialization.

patch.reasoning: The recurring patterns are already addressed by the skill’s endpoint-selection, coverage, schema-validation, pagination, and value-mapping rules. Additional text would duplicate existing guidance, while some mismatches depend on ambiguous prompts or questionable expected values.
